title: Cursor Hooks Configuration
description: JSON Schema for Cursor hooks.json configuration files

beforeShellExecution.description: Path to script that runs before shell commands are executed

afterShellExecution.description: Path to script that runs after shell commands are executed

beforeMCPExecution.description: Path to script that runs before MCP tool calls

afterMCPExecution.description: Path to script that runs after MCP tool calls

beforeReadFile.description: Path to script that runs before files are read

afterFileEdit.description: Path to script that runs after files are edited

beforeSubmitPrompt.description: Path to script that runs before prompts are submitted

stop.description: Path to script that runs when agent loop stops

afterAgentResponse.description: Path to script that runs after agent responses

afterAgentThought.description: Path to script that runs after agent thoughts

beforeTabFileRead.description: Path to script that runs before tab file reads

afterTabFileEdit.description: Path to script that runs after tab file edits
